boundaries: SARU remains WATCH and TA remains CANDIDATE.
L02 reuse does not change L03 provenance or promote either asset.
VANUVALI and VANI remain in the Source Lock inventory and are not deleted.
The proposal does not claim that the two unresolved historical forms correspond to SARU or TA.
No sentence grammar or pedagogy is created by this proposal.
